description:
This plugin provides a Workday synchronization configuration for your Memority tenant.

        It configures a SOAP REST connector, an application, a synchronization task and the related settings.

        Use it on a tenant project that you initialized with the **Initialize project** action of MIT.

        Please refer to the [documentation](https://doc.memority.eu/setup-guide/latest/workday-synchronization-plugin) before use.
